title: Williamson Dacar Associates
description: williamsondacar.com zoominfo.com/c/williamson-dacar-associates-inc/131629505 Williamson Dacar Associates, Inc. (founded 1994, Clearwater, Florida; now branded Williamson Design Associates / WDA Studio, wdastudio.com) is an award-winning small-business architecture, engineering and interior-design firm specializing in Florida's K-12 schools, colleges, libraries, government buildings and houses of worship. Led by founder and President Ted Williamson, AIA, PE with ~31 staff and offices in Clearwater and Boca Raton, the firm has completed 300+ educational projects over 30+ years — including a $796K jail secure-entry-center contract for Pinellas County, major campus renovations for Pinellas/Palm Beach/Volusia school districts, and new facilities for St. Petersburg College, Palm Beach State College and New College of Florida. Its South Florida co-director Thomas Donaudy (ex-Florida Atlantic University architect, 200+ school projects) retired in January 2026, marking a leadership transition
